result.summary: The page is largely coherent, but the 'Fastest near you' carousel has a clear vertical misalignment: the middle card (Smash Bros Burgers) is shifted down relative to its neighbors, breaking the row's baseline grid. A few smaller cosmetic/consistency issues exist (inconsistent favorite-button treatment, low-contrast placeholder and link text). Horizontal clipping at the right edge and the bottom-cut card were treated as intended behavior.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' row, the second card (Smash Bros Burgers) is vertically offset ~25px lower than the first and third cards. Its image, title, and delivery-fee line do not align with the neighboring cards, making the row look broken/staggered.
issues.suggestion: Align all carousel cards to a common top edge and use fixed image heights/aspect ratios so titles and metadata share the same baselines across the row.

issues.description: Favorite (heart) buttons are styled inconsistently between cards: the Tokumaru Ramen card shows a bare white heart with no background, while the pizza card below uses a heart inside a dark circular chip.
issues.suggestion: Apply a single consistent favorite-button component (e.g., always a semi-transparent dark circular background) so it reads identically and stays legible over any image.

issues.description: The search field placeholder ('Restaurants, dishes, groceries') is light gray on a very light gray fill, giving weak contrast that may be hard to read in bright conditions.
issues.suggestion: Darken the placeholder text (or the field background) to reach at least 4.5:1 contrast against the input fill.

issues.description: The green 'See all' links and the gray secondary metadata (delivery fees, '25–35 min · €0 delivery · Ramen') are relatively low contrast against the white background at small text sizes.
issues.suggestion: Use a slightly darker green for links and a darker gray for secondary text to meet WCAG AA contrast for small text.
